releases.note: Buffer bounded gateway responses before committing their status, so a truncated small upstream response can become 502 instead of a misleading successful response. Verified 502 on premature EOF, correct non-200 body and HEAD length, plus independent per-client/global burst, refill, health bypass, denied-origin isolation and upstream header filtering. Visible smoke checks pass; very large origin bodies still stream and cannot be replaced after delivery begins.

releases.note: Fix: accept opaque non-NUL header-value bytes instead of rejecting controls, while retaining malformed-line and folding protections. A targeted client test confirms 0x01/0x80/0x7f values succeed, while NUL, folding and bare LF return 400; visible smoke remains passing. Separate admission test confirms client/global 429s never reach the origin, trusted X-Real-IP separation, health exemption, URI/Host preservation and binary response relay.
